description.en: Sidebar sticky-note wall: freely placed colour-coded notes, checklists, one-click folding, a trash drawer that restores deleted notes, drag and resize, per-note persistence across sessions, and five sticky_wall_* model tools for writing and restoring notes from chat.
description.zh: 侧栏便签墙：可自由摆放的彩色便签、待办勾选、一键折叠、可恢复的回收站抽屉、拖拽与改尺寸、跨会话保持摆放，并给模型 5 个 sticky_wall_* 工具，从对话里记便签和恢复便签。
